records.jp: おかしい。確かに紫乃の存在を近くに感じるのに、<CR>まったく見つけられないなんて
records.en_original: This is strange. I can definitely sense Shino close by, but we can't seem to find her at all.
records.en: This is strange. I can definitely sense Shino close by,<CR>but we can't seem to find her at all.

records.jp: もしかして、本当はもっと遠くにいるのかな？
records.en_original: Maybe she's actually farther away than we think?
records.en: Maybe she's actually farther away than we think?

records.jp: ……ううん。<CR>この近くには絶対いると思う
records.en_original: No. I'm sure she's somewhere close.
records.en: No. I'm sure<CR>she's somewhere close.

records.jp: この溶岩は紫乃の怒りそのものだから
records.en_original: This lava is the very embodiment of Shino's anger.
records.en: This lava is the very embodiment of Shino's anger.

records.jp: 大人に翻弄された、彼女の苦しみ。<CR>今の紫乃を動かす一番の感情が、この溶岩
records.en_original: Her pain is born from being manipulated by adults. The strongest emotion driving Shino right now is this lava.
records.en: Her pain is born from being manipulated by adults.<CR>The strongest emotion driving Shino right now is this lava.

records.jp: なら、この近くにいるのは間違いない。<CR>私たちが見つけられてないだけだよ
records.en_original: So, she has to be nearby. We're just not able to find her yet.
records.en: So, she has to be nearby.<CR>We're just not able to find her yet.

records.jp: この溶岩は、紫乃ちゃんの怒り。<CR>紫乃ちゃんを動かしている一番の感情……
records.en_original: This lava is the manifestation of Shino's anger. It's the main emotion driving her right now...
records.en: This lava is the manifestation of Shino-chan's anger.<CR>It's the main emotion driving her right now...

records.jp: だとしたら！
records.en_original: If that's the case, then fine!
records.en: If that's the case!

records.jp: 陽桜莉、何を――っ！！
records.en_original: Hiori, what are you—
records.en: Hiori, what are you—

records.jp: 老いた者、病める者、貧しき者、無知なる者
records.en_original: The old, the sickly, the poor, the uneducated.
records.en: The old, the sickly, the poor, the uneducated.

records.jp: これらは害悪でしかないのです。<CR>これらが未来を滅ぼすのです
records.en_original: They are nothing but a plague to society. These weak individuals will ruin the future.
records.en: They are nothing but harmful.<CR>They are what will destroy the future.

records.jp: それが、母が私に押し付けた、聖イネス教の教えだった
records.en_original: That's what my mother forced into my head—those were the teachings of St. Ines.
records.en: That's what my mother forced into my head—those were the teachings of St. Ines.

records.jp: 新興宗教・聖イネス教は、母が立ち上げた宗教団体だ
records.en_original: This new religion, the St. Ines Faith, is a religious group my mother founded.
records.en: This new religion, the St. Ines Faith, is a religious group my mother founded.

records.jp: そこでの私は、教祖ネクナンとして<CR>教団の顔であり象徴として崇められていた
records.en_original: There, I was worshiped as the founder, Nekunan—the face and symbol of the cult.
records.en: There, I was worshiped as the founder,<CR>Nekunan—the face and symbol of the cult.

records.jp: 母の作り出した設定では、私ことネクナンは未来人で、<CR>教えを告げるために現代に降臨したとのことだ
records.en_original: According to my mother's scriptures, I, Nekunan, was supposedly from the future. I returned to this era to deliver a holy message.
records.en: According to my mother's scriptures, I, Nekunan, was supposedly from the future.<CR>I returned to this era to deliver a holy message.

records.jp: もちろん、私は未来人なんかではない
records.en_original: Of course, I'm not really some person from the future.
records.en: Of course, I'm not really some person from the future.

records.jp: 母の用意した言葉を、母に代わって人々の前で<CR>語るだけの操り人形でしかない
records.en_original: I was nothing more than a puppet, reciting sermons my mother prepared, standing before crowds of followers in her place.
records.en: I was nothing more than a puppet, reciting sermons my mother prepared,<CR>standing before crowds of followers in her place.

records.jp: 私は母に代わり「弱いものは悪だ」という教えを<CR>広める役割を続けていた
records.en_original: I took on the role of spreading my mother's teachings, preaching the evils of the weak and helpless.
records.en: I kept spreading my mother's teaching<CR>that "the weak are evil."

records.jp: 本心ではそんなこと思っていなかった。<CR>言いたくもなかった
records.en_original: I never truly believed in it. I never even wanted to say it.
records.en: I never truly believed in it.<CR>I never even wanted to say it.

records.jp: けれど、子供の私にそれを拒むことはできなかった
records.en_original: But as a child, there was no way I could refuse.
records.en: But as a child, there was no way I could refuse.

records.jp: そんな日々に耐えられず、逃げ出したこともあった
records.en_original: There were days I couldn't take it anymore and tried to run away.
records.en: There were days I couldn't take it anymore and tried to run away.

records.jp: 逃げるあてなどどこにもなかったが、<CR>どこだろうと母の元にいるよりマシだと思った
records.en_original: I had nowhere to go, but anywhere seemed better than staying with my mother.
records.en: I had nowhere to go,<CR>but anywhere seemed better than staying with my mother.

records.jp: 今にして思えば、自分の考えがどれほど甘かったかと<CR>後悔しかないが……
records.en_original: Looking back on all of that now, I regret how naive I was...
records.en: Looking back on all of that now, I regret how<CR>naive I was...

records.jp: 私はすぐに母に見つかり、教団へと連れ戻された
records.en_original: My mother found me right away and brought me back to the cult.
records.en: My mother found me right away and brought me back to the cult.

records.jp: 悪だ
records.en_original: All this evil...
records.en: Evil.

records.jp: 大人の悪こそが世界を狂わせた
records.en_original: The evil of adults is what drove this world insane.
records.en: The evil of adults is what drove this world insane.

records.jp: あの女は私たちを飼いならし、好きなように利用し、<CR>大勢の人を苦しめた
records.en_original: That woman manipulated us, used us however she pleased, and made so many people suffer.
records.en: That woman manipulated us, used us however she pleased,<CR>and made so many people suffer.

records.jp: 老いることも、<CR>病むことも貧しいことも悪いことじゃない
records.en_original: Getting old, getting sick, or being poor—none of those are evil things.
records.en: Getting old,<CR>getting sick, or being poor—none of those are evil things.

records.jp: 本当の悪は、<CR>それを弱いもの呼ばわりする歪んだ想いだ！
records.en_original: The real evil is the twisted mindset that would call people suffering under those conditions weak!
records.en: The real evil is the twisted<CR>mindset that would call people suffering under those conditions weak!

records.jp: ママ、あなたこそが悪です
records.en_original: Mom, you are the true evil.
records.en: Mama, you are the true evil.

records.jp: この指輪が、あなたの想いを守ってくれる
records.en_original: This ring will protect your feelings.
records.en: This ring will protect your feelings.

records.jp: 違う
records.en_original: No.
records.en: No.

records.jp: 守ってほしいのは想いなんかじゃない
records.en_original: It's not my feelings that I want protected.
records.en: It's not my feelings that I want protected.

records.jp: 現実を守ってもらえないのであれば、<CR>なんの解決にもならない
records.en_original: If reality can't be protected, then it solves nothing.
records.en: If reality can't be protected,<CR>then it solves nothing.

records.jp: リフレクターでは、誰も救うことはできない
records.en_original: A Reflector can't really save anyone.
records.en: A Reflector can't really save anyone.

records.jp: 本当の悪は弱いものを悪と呼ぶ大人の歪んだ想いだ
records.en_original: The real evil is the warped adult mindset that would call the weak "evil."
records.en: The real evil is the warped adult mindset that would call the weak "evil."

records.jp: 私は、それをこの世から一掃する
records.en_original: I'll wipe that thought from this world.
records.en: I'll wipe that thought from this world.

records.jp: 人間たちの愚かな想いをコントロールし、<CR>優しい世界を創る
records.en_original: I'll control humanity's foolish hearts and create a gentler, kinder world.
records.en: I'll control humanity's foolish hearts and create a gentler,<CR>kinder world.

records.jp: 苦しみも悲しみも痛みからも解放された、<CR>想いのない、穏やかな世界を
records.en_original: A world without pain, sadness, or suffering—an emotionless, peaceful world.
records.en: A world without pain, sadness, or suffering—an emotionless,<CR>peaceful world.

records.jp: ……紫乃ちゃんは、想いを守ってもらうことを<CR>望んでいるわけじゃない
records.en_original: Shino doesn't wish for her feelings to be protected...
records.en: Shino-chan doesn't wish for her feelings<CR>to be protected...

records.jp: 現実を守ってほしいと思ってる紫乃ちゃんを、<CR>私たちは……助けられるのかな？
records.en_original: She wants reality to be protected. Can we really save her?
records.en: Can we really save Shino-chan,<CR>when she wants reality protected...?

records.jp: ……やっぱり、やめる？<CR>紫乃のところへ行くの
records.en_original: ...Maybe we should stop trying to find Shino after all.
records.en: ...Should we call it off after all?<CR>Going to Shino, I mean.

records.jp: 紫乃ちゃんの想いはわかったけど、<CR>紫乃ちゃんの望む世界は……間違ってる
records.en_original: I understand how Shino feels, but the world she wants...it's all wrong.
records.en: I understand how Shino-chan feels,<CR>but the world she wants...it's all wrong.

records.jp: だから、私は行くよ。それに気づいてもらうために
records.en_original: That's why I'm going. So that she can realize that herself.
records.en: That's why I'm going. So that she can realize that herself.

records.jp: よかった……私と同じ想いで。<CR>陽桜莉が、私のバディで……
records.en_original: I'm so glad... We feel the same. Hiori, you really are my partner...
records.en: I'm so glad... We feel the same.<CR>Hiori, you really are my partner...

records.jp: 紫乃ちゃんは、この溶岩の下にいる。<CR>行こう、瑠夏ちゃん
records.en_original: Shino is under this lava. Let's go, Ruka.
records.en: Shino-chan is under this lava.<CR>Let's go, Ruka-chan.

records.jp: うん。みんなの想いが力をくれたんだもの。<CR>絶対に止めてみせる
records.en_original: Yeah. Everyone's feelings have given us strength. We have to stop her, no matter what.
records.en: Yeah. Everyone's feelings have given us strength.<CR>We have to stop her, no matter what.
